data.name: Ping 監測設定
Ping 監測
從中央位置持續量測所有已啟用設備的主要與額外目標。
data.value: Continuously measure primary and additional targets of enabled devices from the central location.

data.name: 每輪每目標發送一次。未達門檻時維持先前狀態；DNS、權限或監測器錯誤顯示未知，不算設備失敗。Ping 不通不代表 Agent 或應用服務故障。
data.value: One Ping is sent to each target per round. Previous status remains until the threshold is reached. DNS, permission and monitor errors show as unknown and do not count as device failures. A failed Ping does not imply Agent or application failure.

data.name: 無法讀取設定，請稍後重新整理。
data.value: Unable to load settings. Refresh later.

data.name: 逾時（1～10 秒，須小於間隔）
連續失敗門檻（1～10 次）
連續成功門檻（1～10 次）
每個 Worker 最大並行數（1～256）
超過兩個量測間隔且至少 90 秒沒有資料，會標記資料過期。Worker 重新啟動會恢復排程，停機期間的取樣不會補造。
data.value: Data becomes stale after more than two measurement intervals and at least 90 seconds without data. The Worker resumes scheduling after restart; samples missed during downtime are not fabricated.

data.value: Check setting ranges; timeout must be less than the measurement interval.

data.name: Ping 資料保存
設定原始量測與五分鐘彙總的保存期限。
data.value: Set retention for raw measurements and five-minute rollups.

data.name: 過期資料會定期清理；尚未完成彙總的樣本會保留。刪除後，延長期限無法還原資料。
data.value: Expired data is cleaned periodically; samples awaiting rollup are retained. Extending retention cannot restore deleted data.

data.name: 無法讀取保存設定，請重新整理後再試。
data.value: Unable to load retention settings. Refresh and try again.

data.value: As of {0}, an estimated {1} raw samples and {2} rollups qualify for cleanup. Actual counts change over time and with data.

data.name: 確認後將依排程清理；預覽在 5 分鐘內有效。
data.value: After confirmation, cleanup follows its schedule. The preview is valid for 5 minutes.
